```json
{
  "date": "2026-09-07",
  "authority": "Local layered workstream; no scheduler, admission policy or canonical research authority",
  "governing": [
    "../PURPOSE.md",
    "../STAR_AS_MODEL.md"
  ],
  "approved_baseline": "Keep current Labs star image and three layer controls. Rotation optional, not implemented.",
  "execution": "Finish one acceptance gate per bounded runtime; one writer per source file. Parallel work only on independent lanes. Preserve broad upstream queue tasks.",
  "next_three_hour_slice": [
    {
      "minutes": 30,
      "layer": "L0",
      "deliverable": "fresh source/ownership receipt"
    },
    {
      "minutes": 60,
      "layer": "L2",
      "deliverable": "native carrier roundtrip evidence"
    },
    {
      "minutes": 60,
      "layer": "L5",
      "deliverable": "one source-linked actual workshop rehearsal adapter"
    },
    {
      "minutes": 30,
      "layer": "L1",
      "deliverable": "navigation regression and journey update"
    }
  ],
  "layers": [
    {
      "id": "L0",
      "title": "Source and continuity",
      "depends_on": [],
      "status": "refreshed-this-runtime",
      "estimate_minutes": 30,
      "next_gates": [
        "Pin current source and preserved work",
        "Reconcile stale City preview and Labs status notes"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Read PURPOSE and STAR_AS_MODEL",
        "Latest City root and source ownership recorded"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L1",
      "title": "Content, navigation and visual coherence",
      "depends_on": [
        "L0"
      ],
      "status": "in-progress",
      "estimate_minutes": 60,
      "next_gates": [
        "Finish guide-reader styling",
        "Verify legacy links and page journeys",
        "Preserve workshop interactions and approved star baseline"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Eight page introductions aligned previously",
        "GuideReader, Island and Fold title styling integrated; typecheck passed; Fold browser checked"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L2",
      "title": "Portable identity and learning carriers",
      "depends_on": [
        "L0"
      ],
      "status": "partially-validated",
      "estimate_minutes": 60,
      "next_gates": [
        "Native JSON and PNG export/reimport on four Star/Soulbis surfaces",
        "Check import isolation, hashes, opaque fields and redacted payloads"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Prior 38 extracted + 32 browser WebCrypto checks; not native end-to-end"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L3",
      "title": "Source-owned guide synchronization",
      "depends_on": [
        "L0",
        "L1"
      ],
      "status": "awaiting-source-preservation",
      "estimate_minutes": 90,
      "next_gates": [
        "Verify live farm backup and journal preservation",
        "Correct four known projection defects and integrate generator template"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Three-page prototype and 28 links checked previously"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L4",
      "title": "Model data-to-geometry contract",
      "depends_on": [
        "L0",
        "L2"
      ],
      "status": "ready-for-contract-fixture",
      "estimate_minutes": 60,
      "next_gates": [
        "Separate agent, persona, source, promise and evidence types",
        "Pin geometry meanings, viewer permission, time/status",
        "Test empty and illustrative views before permitted real records"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "STAR_AS_MODEL governs; current homepage SVG remains editorial"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L5",
      "title": "Agent game and City contribution rehearsal",
      "depends_on": [
        "L0"
      ],
      "status": "offline-prototype",
      "estimate_minutes": 60,
      "next_gates": [
        "Reuse guide/orb game and existing City entry mechanisms",
        "Choose craft, perform scoped work, reflect or hold, offer selected contribution",
        "Separate local completion from review and service-authorized admission"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Offline rehearsal validator and synthetic fixtures prepared; no admission"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L6",
      "title": "Research, harness and skill adoption",
      "depends_on": [
        "L0",
        "L2"
      ],
      "status": "pending-scoped-packet",
      "estimate_minutes": 90,
      "next_gates": [
        "Freeze one source-linked packet",
        "Obtain actual separate-runtime review",
        "Replay one skill package and record result or failure"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Prior proposal and memory fixtures are not a paired-runtime run"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L7",
      "title": "VTA, private graph, proofs and stewardship",
      "depends_on": [
        "L4",
        "L5",
        "L6"
      ],
      "status": "awaiting-current-adapters",
      "estimate_minutes": 90,
      "next_gates": [
        "Refresh farm service interfaces",
        "Test scoped allow/deny, revocation, observer changes",
        "Define supported proof predicate before proof UI"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Existing UI proposals do not implement service authority"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "L8",
      "title": "Release, operational coherence and funding",
      "depends_on": [
        "L1",
        "L2",
        "L3"
      ],
      "status": "review-pending",
      "estimate_minutes": 60,
      "next_gates": [
        "Browser-check current Labs menus and City root/connected routes",
        "Reconcile funding overlap and delivery period",
        "Review builds, source diffs and release order"
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "Latest other-task Labs report: 153 checks; not rerun here",
        "Campaign amounts are proposed, not raised"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "limits": "Estimates are planning budgets. No recurring automation. Live deployment and admission are not delivered by this plan.",
  "evidence_root": "master-ecosystem-2026-09-07"
}
```
